objective: Make the creator onboarding workflow safe, understandable, and reversible.

recommendations.title: Expose exact approval scope
recommendations.rationale: A concise transaction preview reduces accidental remote or paid actions.
recommendations.proposedChange: Add a human-readable approval summary before remote execution.
evidence: The sanitized brief describes separate policy and per-call gates.
acceptanceTests: The preview identifies remote egress and unknown cost independently.
